risk: Message Loss via Unhandled Gateway Conditions
consequence: Messages not matching predefined SalesOrder or ReturnSalesOrder predicates reach EscalationEndEvent (EndEvent_11) with 'RoutingConditionNotMet'. If no parent monitoring alerts on Escalation, orders remain unfulfilled.
mitigation: Unit tests assert that default route SequenceFlow_110 explicitly sets escalation error codes and returns unambiguous status codes (422) for DLQ / retry queue ingestion.

risk: Payload Loss during Exception Subprocess Handling
consequence: CallActivity_97 overwrites the exchange body using '${property.InputPayload}'. If CallActivity_4 fails before property initialization, the logged body will be null, obscuring diagnostic audit trails.
mitigation: Test case TC_GLOVIA_04 verifies that exchange property 'InputPayload' retains the original incoming body string prior to error handling and script logging.

risk: Orphaned Processing Steps and Dead Code
consequence: CallActivity_77 (Groovy script GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and CallActivity_86 are defined in BPMN but have no incoming sequence flows, indicating incomplete refactoring or dead code paths.
mitigation: Document unlinked flow steps in coverage analysis and verify runtime routing purely relies on gateway XPath conditions rather than orphaned Groovy steps.

risk: Namespace Handling Failure in XML Evaluation
consequence: XmlSlurper logic vs BPMN XPath expressions discrepancies: Salesforce Outbound Message namespaces ('http://soap.sforce.com/2005/09/outbound') can cause XPath mismatch if prefix bindings vary.
mitigation: Payload test suites explicitly define ns1 and ns2 declarations to validate strict namespace-aware evaluation.
